hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.java) head -25 "$f" | grep -q 'GNU Lesser General Public License' || printf '{"systemMessage":"%s is missing the LGPL v3 license header. Copy it from a neighbouring file and update the filename and copyright lines."}\n' "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
